Hi Maya — great to meet you (virtually) and thanks for the intake doc.

Short answers up front:
- We can usually onboard with a single master seller agreement for Redwood’s marketplace integration; some marketplaces still need a marketplace-specific addendum. Irene (cc'd) is our marketplace intake lead and will confirm any addenda required for AWS/Azure/GCP.
- Typical activation window after we have completed paperwork and a PO: 7–12 business days for standard listings; expedited lane (3–5 biz days) possible if paperwork + PO + bank remit are complete and verified.
- Consolidated billing: we support a consolidated billing option for enterprise customers but that requires finance approval and mapping of payor info per marketplace.

Next steps I can execute today:
1) I’ll send a short intake checklist (DocuSign) with the exact fields we need (W-9, remit instructions, bank remit file) — please sign/return.
2) Irene will confirm whether marketplace addenda are required and share the expected timeline per cloud provider.
3) If you can provide a preferred target activation date we’ll slot you into an onboarding sprint and flag for expedited processing if needed.

CC'ing Vanessa (partnerships) and Irene so they have context. Expect the DocuSign link in a follow-up from me within the hour.

Best,
